title: Hello
description: Hello message written by the mobile app to the station on BLE characteristic FFF3. Opens the handshake. It is plaintext and any radio in range can read it, so it carries nothing that identifies the device or its user (06-security.md T14); the device is identified only inside the channel, by the credential it presents.

bleVersions.description: The BLE protocol versions the app supports, most preferred first (VERSIONING.md, 'BLE Protocol Version'). The station names one of them in the Challenge's bleVersion, or refuses the Hello with 1007 when it supports none (profiles/offline/ble-handshake.md §3).

appNonce.description: Base64-encoded 32-byte cryptographically random nonce (exactly 44 Base64 characters; N16 — was minLength:1).

appVersion.description: Semantic version of the mobile application

appEphemeralPubKey.description: The app's per-handshake ephemeral P-256 public key (compressed SEC1, Base64). Its ECDH with the station's ephemeral key is the session key's input (06-security.md §6.5). Freshly generated per handshake and discarded after the session.
